title: Free SEO Title Checker – Score Any Headline Instantly
description: Check any blog headline or meta title in seconds — pixel-accurate Google preview, length scoring and CTR tips. Free, instant, no signup.

faqs.question: How do I optimize a headline for SEO and clicks?
faqs.answer: High-performing headlines should be between 6 and 12 words, include numbers or brackets, contain power words, and front-load target keywords.

faqs.question: What is the optimal length for an SEO title tag?
faqs.answer: The optimal title length is between 50 and 60 characters or 580 pixels on desktop viewports.

faqs.question: Why does Google rewrite page title tags?
faqs.answer: Google rewrites title tags if they are truncated, keyword-stuffed, or poorly matched to the user search query.

meta.heading: Meta Title & Description Checker
meta.subheading: Test your exact <title> and meta description against Google’s real pixel limits with a live search preview.

metaTips.titleTooLong: Title is too long (over 60 chars or 580px). It will get truncated.
metaTips.titleTooShort: Title is too short (under 40 chars). Add more descriptive keywords.
metaTips.descTooLong: Description is too long. Keep it under 160 characters.
metaTips.descTooShort: Description is too short. Describe your page in 110-160 characters.
metaTips.keywordMissing: Keyword not found in title. Try inserting it naturally.
metaTips.hasPowerWord: Title contains a CTR power word.
metaTips.missingPowerWord: Consider adding power words (e.g. "free", "best", "guide") to boost clicks.
